# Vendored libraries

Fetched from jsDelivr as ESM bundles and re-pointed at each other locally so the
page has no third-party runtime dependency. All three are ISC licensed.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `d3-geo.js` | [d3-geo](https://github.com/d3/d3-geo) | 3.1.1 | ISC |
| `d3-array.js` | [d3-array](https://github.com/d3/d3-array) | 3.2.4 | ISC |
| `internmap.js` | [internmap](https://github.com/mbostock/internmap) | 2.0.3 | ISC |
| `topojson-client.js` | [topojson-client](https://github.com/topojson/topojson-client) | 3.1.0 | ISC |
